blocks.html: This reference shows all the events emitted by the Medusa application related to the Fulfillment Module. If you use the module outside the Medusa application, these events aren't emitted.

events.name: shipment.created
events.description: Emitted when a shipment is created for an order.

events.name: delivery.created
events.description: Emitted when a fulfillment is marked as delivered.

events.name: shipping-option.created
events.description: Emitted when shipping options are created.

events.name: shipping-option.updated
events.description: Emitted when shipping options are updated.

events.name: shipping-option.deleted
events.description: Emitted when shipping options are deleted.

events.name: shipping-option-type.updated
events.description: Emitted when shipping option types are updated.

events.name: shipping-option-type.created
events.description: Emitted when shipping option types are created.

events.name: shipping-option-type.deleted
events.description: Emitted when shipping option types are deleted.
